**Daily Devotional**

**May 26**

*5 For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus; (1 Timothy 2:5 KJV)*

This verse is telling us that Jesus is the only Mediator between man and God, so anyone who is trying to mediate between man and God is actually being antichrist, otherwise trying to take the place of Christ. Moses was the mediator in the Old Covenant (Galatians 3:19), and that was okay, as Christ had not yet come. Now that Jesus has come and not only been our Mediator, but our Savior, and imparted His righteousness to us, we are now able to go directly into the presence of the Father. Wow, thank you Jesus.

By using the name of Jesus, our Mediator and Savior, we can have access to all the benefits that He has, and have become joint-heirs with Him to all that God has (Romans 8:17). If the Christian could just realize what all has already been given us, by the Grace of God, we could walk in victory here in this life, and not have to wait for our going to heaven to have all the benefits, like deliverance, healing and prosperity. I believe I will just go ahead and make my life here on earth, just like heaven, by taping into the gifts I have already been given. Why don’t you also? Praise God for all His blessings to us, His children.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com

How Long To Fall Through The Earth?
Wouldn't you stop halfway through and end up orbiting the gravitational center? For the second half of the journey you'd have to be falling uphill.

Newton's Second Law is why. Objects traveling in motion behave as defined by the kinematic equations of motion, which are derived from the Second Law. When you jump into the hole, your potential energy becomes kinetic energy, and you begin to accelerate towards the center of the Earth due to the influence of gravity. As you accelerate, you increase in speed (velocity), since you have a velocity you translate (move some distance). When you reach the center of the Earth, you've reached your maximum speed, and your acceleration falls to zero (as no outside force acts on you). You do not decelerate as you approach the center of the Earth, as no opposite force vector acts on you until you pass it (the center of the Earth). After you pass the center, then you begin to decelerate, as gravity is now acting as that opposite force vector, allowing your corpse to casually fall up the other end of the whole, since you would have suffocated during your half hour fall.

Firstly, the relatively low caloric density of whole plant food means that a person can eat a great deal more without taking in too many calories. Next, the fiber and nutrient content of whole foods effectively blunts and regulates blood sugar to avoid spikes and crashes that might otherwise lead a person into binge cycles. Then there's the fact that the conversion of carbohydrates to fat is only 70% efficient. That means 30% of your excess carbs are burned up in the conversion process.
